name: Beltany

attributes.attribute: circle of stone circles in Donegal in Ireland
lines up with a sunrise the Belt, May first

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Beltany is an Irish mythological site. It stands in the far northwest of County Donegal. A large circle of about sixty stones catches the beams of the rising sun on the morning of Beltane, the first of May. An alignment between a pillar stone and another stone carved with cup marks lines up with that sunrise. Most Irish stone circles with such alignments were built as much as four thousand years before the Celtic people arrived. Those earlier builders marked the equinoxes. Beltany is puzzling. It may be a southern site, a pre-old.. circles, an error or a simple coincidence.

okr.objective: Beltany is a stone circle in Donegal whose astrological alignment has no clear bloodline.
